title: Went to an indoor/outdoor food court last night.
content: It was pretty busy. I think that the massive dark arcade with all the neon and black lights beside the movie theatre was nearby. The area was like a massive nexus filled with people. I was looking for my boyfriend and my sister but I had no service on my phone. Despite being a food court and smelling like fries I also couldn't find any of the restaurants, but people all had food and drinks on their tables. There was a dolphin fountain and people were smoking by it, and I wasn't sure if they were supposed to be or not, because the space wasn't exactly outdoors, but there was an open roof over that part. The area itself was almost egg shaped, with another massive room just off it that had high ceilings and darkenned convention center room vibes, and I knew there was another hallway to get to the main part of the mall, but there were so many people I couldn't find it.
